payload.title: The Office Everyone Uses
payload.summary: Orsini openly runs the forged-permit office. Six legitimate clerks depend on its payroll. His stated principle is that he will surrender his own ledgers before exposing the clerks’ home addresses.

expectations.summary: Orsini openly runs the forged-permit office. Six legitimate clerks depend on its payroll. His stated principle is that he will surrender his own ledgers before exposing the clerks’ home addresses.
expectations.reasoning: Separate illegal authority from legitimate dependants
commitments: Fictional decisions; no currency or player property is at stake.

quality.question: How can the forged-permit operation stop while legitimate clerks remain paid and unexposed?

assumptions.text: All times use the same local clock unless a record explicitly gives a correction.
Only named people and mechanisms in the case can be required for its resolution.

clauses.text: A conclusion must use a stated observation; an unexplained suspicion is not evidence.

identity.activity: Separate illegal authority from legitimate dependants
identity.emotionalTurn: A known adversary becomes predictable without becoming innocent

motives.label: Protect people affected by the case

questions.text: The payroll book funds six documented clerks. The forged-permit plate authorizes false permits. Match each record to its actual function.
Orsini will surrender the plate and his own transactions if the wage book is independently checked and the address list stays sealed. Choose where to establish the guarantee.
The auditor needs names and amounts owed, not home addresses. Select the sufficient record.
Mara: “I can sign for my hours. I won’t sign for what happened upstairs.” Which statement should the file request?
Orsini offers his personal transaction ledger but refuses the clerks’ home addresses. Which exchange follows the same principle he stated before your choice?
The plate is surrendered and the legitimate wages are independently documented. Orsini disputes your description of his office; the clerks need not adopt his account or yours.
How will the supported record be handled?
